items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: I dedicated it to Harold's wife, who's passed away. Her name was Rose.

ctx.x: The label is Olympia label. I use Rose label. And we have another label. And these different things, such as the Rose label, there's a lot of things I like to do on gospel. And I dedicated it to Harold's wife, who's passed away. Her name was Rose. And Dubat Publishing is Duke or Dejan and Bat Ming. You understand?
